profile.name: 轮询式内部伪设备
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于以后台轮询方式监测操作系统或主机内部状态，并将结果表现为可触发激活/失活事件的“伪设备”。它适合在实验自动化中把网络连通性、CPU 温度、系统负载、时间窗口或磁盘占用等内部条件，作为控制其他真实实验设备或流程逻辑的触发信号。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that polls operating-system or host-internal state in the background and exposes it as a pseudo-device with active/inactive events. It is useful in lab automation for turning internal conditions such as network reachability, CPU temperature, system load, time windows, or disk usage into triggers for controlling real instruments or experimental workflows.

registry.name: Polled Internal
registry.description: Polled Internal Device是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、加载、启动。支持Signal, Slot, end time等操作。
